name: R-5 live: all four Papercusp/* Cupboard mirrors protect main with cupboard-verify required and the latest cupboard-verify run on main green
command: {allow_deletions,allow_force_pushes,enforce_admins,linear,required_status_checks,strict}; then gh run list -R Papercusp/<repo> --branch main --workflow cupboard-verify --limit 1
summary: Measured live over the GitHub API at ~14:59Z (the start/finish timestamps are the minute window of the read, not per-call stamps): on all four mirrors main is protected, cupboard-verify is a required status check (strict), force-push and deletion are disallowed, linear history is required, enforce_admins is on, and the latest cupboard-verify run on main concluded success. linear:true and enforce_admins:true on all four mirrors.

gh run list --branch main --workflow cupboard-verify --limit 1: conclusion success, status completed on all four (recipes 2026-09-29T23:32:22Z, goals 2026-09-19T10:03:50Z, plans 2026-09-29T23:32:25Z, templates 2026-09-19T10:07:12Z); headShas in mirrors.<repo>.latestCupboardVerifyRunOnMain.

instrument: gh api repos/Papercusp/<repo>/branches/main/protection --jq (read-only) + gh run list -R Papercusp/<repo> --branch main --workflow cupboard-verify --limit 1; authenticated as GitHub account papercupai

verdict: no BROKEN-if marker holds on any of the four mirrors at measurement time: protection present, cupboard-verify required, force-push and deletion disallowed, linear history required, latest cupboard-verify run on main is success
